title: Bacalhau à Brás: Portuguese-Style Shredded Cod Fritters
description: A rich and savory Portuguese classic, this recipe features crispy fried cod fritters, creamy ricotta, and nostalgic flavors.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the shredded cod and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and let cool to room temperature.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and flour.
Add the egg mixture to the cooled cod mixture and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 8-10 patties.
Heat 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the patties until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with ricotta cheese on top.
